proof_scope: Real intake and existing emit-document-ui CLI against the independently produced ZIP selected by PITCHDECK_INTAKE_PACKAGE. Imports only into new storage directories; no browser windows or working deck changes.

claims.proves: Validation-only leaves no destination; imported canonical JSON, resources and mapping bytes survive exactly; existing browser-payload emission retains notes, slide IDs, animation targets and assets; existing destinations and seeded package faults are refused without destination writes.
claims.does_not_prove: Visual approval, asset sanitization, claim/publication authorization, font installation, debugger workspace execution, browser or native Office animation playback, or authoring-view conversion.
